phase: Recorded before all v1.1 development and held-out flights
heldout_initial_pose_and_native_plant_no: Per-case seed and offsets from plan.json; identical for v1.0 and v1.1 within each matched case
limitations: The mission's optical-flow/range RNG is fixed across cases; only native plant noise and initial pose vary per held-out case. Wall-clock inference/render latency is recorded but is not controlled to be identical. No claim of bit-identical full simulator trajectories across machines. ArduPilot parameters and binary remain unchanged.
